assertions.assertion: Lists passkeys/WebAuthn/FIDO2 as a supported authentication method
assertions.rationale: Passkeys are listed in the methods table and given a dedicated section describing them as WebAuthn/FIDO2 and phishing-resistant.

assertions.assertion: Lists TOTP (authenticator apps) as a supported method
assertions.rationale: TOTP is listed as RFC 6238 time-based codes from authenticator apps, with a fallback section.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that multiple authentication methods can coexist for the same user
assertions.rationale: A section explicitly states a single user can have several methods enrolled simultaneously (passkey + TOTP), enabling the requested setup.

assertions.assertion: Notes that OTP (email/SMS) is the default passwordless flow
assertions.rationale: It states OTP via email/SMS is the default passwordless flow in User Management, both in the table and a dedicated note.
